However, Hurricane Ida (2021) saw a slight increase in its gross ultimate loss estimate.

gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: At the 2023 year end the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 596.9m. Analysis of the claims development triangle indicates an overall gross prior-year release of approximately GBP 32.5m (about 5.5% of opening gross claims), driven primarily by favourable claims development across multiple classes (notably long-tail casualty and motor/auto attritional experience) and benign development on some earlier catastrophe items. This gross release translates to a net surplus (after reinsurance) reported in the accounts; specific named events such as Hurricane Ida (2021), Hurricane Ian (2022) and various 2019-2020 wind events continued to influence gross ultimates but were largely mitigated by reinsurance and retrocession arrangements.

The total gross IBNR reserve, less future premiums, started the year at GBP 137.5m.
GBP 17.3m or 12.6% of this reserve was utilised in the calendar year
There was a gross back year release of GBP 20.4m
The long-tail casualty classes generated a GBP 7.0m gross back-year release
The short-tail account generated a GBP 6.6m gross back-year release

The GBP 6.7m gross back-year release is largely driven by the auto account on the 2019 and 2020 years as the benign experience increasingly highlights the different development pattern for these years
A positive run-off of GBP 21.0m on the 2020 and prior years' reserves (2019 and prior: GBP 22.8m) was experienced in the year.
gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Prior-year gross development (-32.517m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (claims ultimate diagonals) because the primary movement note showing GROSS prior-year movement was not explicitly labelled; the report also quotes net prior-year movements (net GBP 23.0m surplus) which differ due to reinsurance recoveries. The syndicate accepted reinsurances/RITCs (notably with Syndicate 6103) during the period which can distort development tables; amounts quoted in the narrative are sometimes in USD. Gross amounts here are computed from the triangle in the notes and rounded to three decimals (millions). Confidence for triangle-derived gross PYD is 0.8; where the report explicitly states gross back-year releases (e.g. casualty GBP 7.0m, motor/auto ~GBP 6.7m) those line items have higher confidence.
